name: Prism laser
pros: Two beams per shot: 52 damage in total (+30%)
balanceNote: Lumen Collective signature part (09 §5): split beam, short range. Uses the existing twin-mount flag, so both beams fire from one trigger. The index counts one beam; with both beams (52 damage) it lands near P 1.0.
notes: Faction signature part (design/09). Art: teardrop alloy housing with Precursor line pattern, short emitter sleeve into a caged crystal prism that splits into two emitter prongs, 0.4 cells above and below the centre line (matches TWIN_GAP).
